Browser extension toolkit (install once, used across phases) · 5/7

The devTools option connects the store

devTools: true (default)

  • Store updates
  • Extension receives actions and state

devTools: false

  • Store updates
  • Extension receives nothing

An options object names the store and sanitizes data.

Safari: the standalone react-devtools

  3. 3Add script src localhost:8097 to the head

Built-in DevTools shows the DOM.

Two extensions show the components and the store

that React and Redux keep behind it.

Install the React DevTools extension.

On a website built with React,

the Components panel and the Profiler panel appear.

In the Components panel, select TodoList and edit its filter prop.

The page then shows the list with the new filter.

Dispatch todoAdded.

The action passes the thunk middleware, then the logger.

The reducer returns the next state,

and the store sends the action and state to the extension.

configureStore sets devTools to true by default.

Set it to false, and the store still updates,

but the extension receives nothing.

Middleware run in array order.

concat puts the logger after the defaults,

so the thunk middleware resolves thunks before the logger sees the action.

Other browsers, such as Safari, use the react-devtools npm package.

Run it, add its script tag to the head, and reload.
